description: Aggregate financial analytics for the organization. Use metric_type to pick the roll-up: 'project_margin_ranking' ranks projects by budget margin (best/worst), 'effective_bill_rate' returns the blended revenue-per-hour, 'utilization_rollup' returns team billable efficiency, 'revenue_summary' returns org budget health plus reported hours. Requires Finance access (Owner, Admin, Finance, or Manager role).

end_date.description: Optional end date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-31). Must be supplied together with start_date.

metric_type.description: Which analytic to return. One of: project_margin_ranking, effective_bill_rate, utilization_rollup, revenue_summary.

start_date.description: Optional start date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01) for effective_bill_rate, utilization_rollup, and revenue_summary. Ignored by project_margin_ranking.

name: get_financial_analytics
title: Get financial analytics
